title: A2A analysis bridge output (worker final answer contract)
description: Operative contract consumed by packages/broker/scripts/a2a-task-handler.mjs from analysis bridge responses. Mirrors the inline instruction in claude-a2a-analysis-bridge.mjs. Used by the piri runner profile via `piri -p --output-schema` (jinwon-int/a2a-nexus#1745 Phase 0, jinwon-int/piri#6).

status.description: Terminal task status. blocked covers block/source_blocked aliases (normalized by the handler).

findings.description: Concrete findings as strings (the handler normalizes to string arrays).

evidenceRefs.description: GitHub issue/PR numbers, file paths, task ids, or fixture ids used as evidence.

verdict.description: Independent review verdict. Required by the worker prompt when payload.review.required=true; omitted for non-review analysis tasks.
